queries.sql: SELECT MIN(doc_date) AS first_date,MAX(doc_date) AS last_date,COUNT(*) AS documents,COUNT(DISTINCT source_system) AS source_systems FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408))
queries.semantic_basis: Census runner MIN/MAX; maximum documentary date is not complete-month certification.

queries.sql: SELECT substr(doc_date,1,7) AS month,COUNT(*) AS documents,MIN(doc_date) AS first_date,MAX(doc_date) AS last_date FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE doc_date>=? GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 12
queries.semantic_basis: Coverage by document date; rows do not certify completeness.

queries.sql: SELECT source_system,doc_entry,doc_num,doc_date,card_code,currency,doc_total,canceled FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) ORDER BY doc_date DESC,TRY_CAST(doc_entry AS BIGINT) DESC LIMIT 10
queries.semantic_basis: Historical source sample ORDER BY DocDate DESC, adapted to pinned facts. DocDate is not ingestion chronology.

queries.sql: SELECT item_code,source_system,canonical_product_id,product_name,inventory_uom_id,sales_uom_id,sap_sell_item FROM read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/reference/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/products/part-00000.parquet') WHERE upper(product_name) LIKE ? ORDER BY item_code LIMIT 30
queries.semantic_basis: Name contains matching identifies candidates, not an approved alias/family resolver.

queries.sql: SELECT currency,canceled,COUNT(*) AS documents,SUM(TRY_CAST(doc_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS document_total FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE doc_date>=? AND doc_date<? GROUP BY currency,canceled ORDER BY currency,canceled
queries.semantic_basis: DocTotal by currency/status; not LineTotal, net after credits, cash collected or product attribution.

queries.sql: SELECT p.item_code,p.product_name,p.sales_uom_id,h.currency,h.canceled,COUNT(*) AS lines,SUM(TRY_CAST(l.quantity AS DECIMAL(38,10))) AS source_quantity,SUM(TRY_CAST(l.line_total AS DECIMAL(38,10))) AS source_line_total FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) h JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) l ON l.source_system=h.source_system AND l.doc_entry=h.doc_entry JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/reference/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/products/part-00000.parquet') p ON p.source_system=l.source_system AND p.item_code=l.item_code WHERE h.doc_date>=? AND h.doc_date<? AND upper(p.product_name) LIKE ? GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY p.item_code,h.currency,h.canceled LIMIT 30
queries.semantic_basis: Registry sales_by_item adapted to bounded period with explicit source keys; quantities remain native, sales UoM is reference and not documentary proof.

queries.sql: SELECT l.item_code,h.currency,h.canceled,COUNT(*) AS lines,SUM(TRY_CAST(l.quantity AS DECIMAL(38,10))) AS native_quantity,SUM(TRY_CAST(l.line_total AS DECIMAL(38,10))) AS native_line_total FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) h JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) l ON l.source_system=h.source_system AND l.doc_entry=h.doc_entry WHERE h.doc_date>=? AND h.doc_date<? AND l.item_code IN ('L02822','L02823','L02877','L03035','L03648','L03649','L03650','L03658') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY l.item_code,h.currency,h.canceled
queries.semantic_basis: Exact SKU evidence from SAP_HANA Reference. Native Atomic namespace SAP_B1_HANA differs: no blind source_system join to Reference.
